title: Raimon's New Wind Blowing!
overview: Matsukaze Tenma, the new protagonist of the series, starts off his adventure by going to Raimon Jr. high. There he meets Otonashi Haruna who shows him around. Soon after, the two make their way to the soccer field, where they see that a soccer team is being beaten-up by Tsurugi Kyousuke, a mysterious boy. There, Tsurugi shot a hissatsu at Matsukaze the latter was able to block it much to everyone's surprise. Later, the real Raimon team appeared, being led by Shindou Takuto.

title: This is the Avatar!
overview: The story continues after Shindou blocked Tsurugi's ball from hitting Tenma and introduced the real Raimon team. They walked down to the soccer field and Shindou asked who he was, in which Kudou replied that Tsurugi was a SEED. Tsurugi challenged Raimon for a soccer match but Shindou refused it as he didn't want to play a match against them for only breaking in and hurting the second team but in reply, Tsurugi shot a ball against the old clubroom and destroyed the door. Everyone was shocked about that and Tsurugi said to Shindou that it wasn't a request but an order.

title: Collapse! Raimon soccer club
overview:
The match ends incompletely, The soccer club begins to collapse! Many of them is gonna leave,

will the soccer club end like that ?

title: Tenma's Entrance Test!
overview: Matsukaze Tenma's dream is close to becoming reality, it's finally time for his test, if he passes he will be able to join the Raimon soccer club! But it won't be easy...

title: Fixed Game
overview: It is revealed that the phone call was a challenge from the team Eito, and the result of the match was fixed. Raimon has to lose by 3-0.

title: The Feelings Put In The Last Pass
overview: The battle of Raimon vs. Eito continues. As Eito already has 3 points, will Raimon be able to catch up?

title: Coach Endou Makes His Appearance
overview: Coach Kudou has left them and so the Raimon Soccer Club has no coach. But now, finally, Endou has returned to take over as the new coach.

title: Captainship
overview: The episode starts off with last year's final match in Holy Road versus Kidokawa Seishuu. Ramion's opponent was leading in the second half by two goals.

title: Finally raising the courtains! Holy Road
overview: Endou suggested to the Raimon team to take part in the Holy Road tournament but seems very troubled at the idea of taking part in the Holy Road. Matsukaze Tenma gets a chance to spend some time with Sangoku Taichi and receives some advice from him. At night, Tenma trained again with Nishizono Shinsuke at Kasenjiki.

title: Rebellion To Victory
overview: The show starts of with Raimon having the lead of 1-0.As the game goes on, the Tengawara team is playing hard-core. They keep tackling Raimon. So anyhow, Sangoku Taichi's mother came and cheered him on. Moments later, one of the players of Tengawara (Hideki)was shown also to have an avatar,(Aviator Falco) making them to have a point. The whistle blows, it's the end of the first half. Will they able to win the match?

title: Tsurugi's Secret
overview: Tsurugi got the ball and kicked it to his team's goal and scored for the other team! How will Raimon win?

title: The Miracle of Keshins! Mannozaka School
overview: Another match starts in the Holy Road tournament but this time it's against Mannouzaka, can they win against the opposing team with such a powerful keshin?

title: Raimon's Awakening?!
overview: The episode starts of with the continuation of the game of Raimon vs. Mannouzaka as of the previous episode. Tsurugi takes the ball from Shinsuke and heads to the goal. Then he is surrounded, and passes the ball to Shindou. He passes the ball to Tenma but only for the ball to be stolen by Mannozaka. Will Raimon win this game?

title: Shinsuke´s Hissatsu Technique
overview: Shinsuke is determined to learn a new hissatsu for their next match! Will he be able to pull it off or will he have to play without a hissatsu at hand?

title: The Battle against Kidou Yuuto !
overview: The next match of Raimon is against.....Teikoku?! And it happens to be that the coach is none other than Kidou Yuuto! Though....why did Kidou take up the position as "Teikoku's Commander"?! Why is Kidou's personality different from before?! Just what has happened?! What are Kidou’s true intentions?! How will Raimon fight against a team with a "commander" that is smart at strategies?!

title: The Fearsome Teikoku Academy
overview: The first half of the Raimon VS. Teikoku match is about to start! Will the Raimon team be able to pull it off somehow even if Tsurugi's not there? And what would be the conclusion of the first half of the match?

title: Explosion! Ultimate Thunder
overview: The tides are arrising at the second half! Who will win?! Teikoku or Raimon?! What will be the conclusion of this match! The true strength of battle starts at the second half! Will they finally pull it off?!

title: Do it! The Revolution!
overview: In this episode, Kidou and all the other people at Teikoku Academy were revealed to be part of a "resistance", secretely fighting against 5th Sector. This group also included coach Kudou, and returning characters like Hibiki Seigou (who seems to be their leader) and Raimon Souichirou, the former Chief Director of Raimon. Former Inazuma players Ichino and Aoyama seemed to still care deeply about the team, especially since they can now play "real soccer". Later on, they were seen enjoying soccer, which Shindou witnessed.

title: The Raging Neptunus Fang!
overview:
Tenma will try to learn new defense hissatsu. Will he be able to succeed?

The Raimon team will play against Kaiou, but all of the opposites players are SEEDs. Will Raimon stand a chance against such monsters?

In this episode, Aoyama and Ichino returned to the team.

Also, this episode features a new opening and ending sequence.

title: Wings! Tenma's Keshin!
overview: Kurama, Sangoku, and Hayami will have their new hissatsu techniques! Tenma was told by Endou to replace Sangoku as the goalkeeper and Sangoku as a defender for the match. And finally; Majin Pegasus, Tenma's Keshin, will appear too.

title: The Autumn Sky Challenger!
overview: A new student at Raimon Jr. High joins Raimon 's soccer club. He's a decent player, as shown in his entrance exam, but he seems to "give off a scary aura"...

title: Wave! The Flag of Revolution
overview: Minamisawa will reappear with a new team (Gassan Kunimitsu) and the goalkeeper, Hyoudou Tsukasa, has a keshin, finally, the 1/8 of the finals start!

title: The Terryfing Cyclone Stadium!
overview: The episode starts with the score shown to be 0-1, in favor of Gassan Kunimitsu as well as Kariya returning to his post to which Kirino remembered what Kariya said in the end of the first half, that Kariya joked that he was actually a SEED to which made Kirino angry at Kariya.

title: Remember! Our Soccer
overview: The end of the match is Raimon's win in the match against Gassan Kunimitsu. Kira Hitomiko is shown to be walking toward at Raimon's old soccer club and talks to Endou about Kariya Masaki's past. Endou Mamoru goes to the base of Fifth Sector and talks to Ishido Shuuji, whom he knows that he's actually Gouenji Shuuya. He asks why Gouenji has changed but instead receives an answer that he is not Gouenji but his name is Ishido. Endou returns home, thinks about the past and looks at the old photo when his whole team; Inazuma Japan won the FFI ten years ago and thinks about Gouenji. A new member also comes in named Kageyama Hikaru, and his last name suprised Endou, Kidou and Haruna.

title: He is Coming Back!
overview: Kageyama Hikaru joins the Raimon team. He trains and it is shown that he is a fast learner. Fubuki Shirou reappears and asks Raimon to help and stop Fifth Sector of taking control on his team, Hakuren. Shindou Takuto states that, Nishiki Ryouma is coming back after playing soccer in the Italian League.

title: Confronting the White Devil!
overview: The Snowland Stadium will appear. Raimon will have a match against Hakuren.

title: The Ice Stadium! Vs Hakuren School
overview: Nishiki Ryouma will return to his previous team which is Raimon and will play against Hakuren in the second half. Also, Yukimura Hyouga realizes that Fubuki Shirou has not betrayed him, contrast to what he thought, and the "light" in his eyes come back. It seems that Kurumada Gouichi and Kageyama Hikaru will be switched into the field. With Nishiki and Hikaru joining the field, and Absolute Barrier will be broken. Also, Endou Mamoru will leave the Raimon team because of investigating of something Fubuki Shirou had told him and leave Kidou Yuuto as the new coach for Raimon.

title: Coach Kidou's Concern
overview: Tobitaka Seiya will appear in GO. It seems that Endou will leave the team for a while and Kidou will take over his position as the coach.

title: The Fated Confrontation! Kidokawa Seishuu
overview: Raimon's next match is against the team they fought in last tournament; Kidokawa Seishuu. And this team is also under Fifth Sector's control. Ishido Shuuji meets up with the coach of Kidokawa Seishuu that is revealed to be none other than Terumi Afuro. Raimon's match against Kidokawa Seishuu starts and Raimon gets a hard time with the match against Kidokawa Seishuu.

title: Magnificant Tactics! Kidou Vs. Aphrodi
overview: Taki Sousuke, Katayama Tsuyoshi and Nishiki Ryouma will use their keshin. Someoka Ryuugo will reappear in Inazuma Eleven GO The episode end's up with Raimon and Kidokawa Seishuu wih the result 2-2 which is a tie.It turns out that Someoka Ryuugo is Nishiki Ryouma former coach

title: Keshin! Sengoku Bushin Musashi Appear!
overview: Nishiki Ryouma and Matsukaze Tenma will use their keshin for the second half of this match. With this, a heated conclusions arrives after the match of Kidokawa Seishuu and Raimon. The match ends with Raimon's win, and Someoka leaves again after his short visit and says his farewell to Kidou and to the Raimon team.

title: Miracle of wind
overview: Tenma, Shinsuke, Aoi, Akane and Midori are at the school fields. Tenma and Shinsuke practices soccer while the manager came to watch them and Midori brought some food. Shinsuke said that he is going to create a keshin and they all discussed on how to awake a keshin.

title: Mysterious enemy! Genei Gakuen!
overview: Revolves around Amagi and his childhood/ flashback are shown. Genei Gakuen will appear. Pinball Stadium made its debut. It is shown that Amemiya Taiyou was wearing hospital clothes. Kudou Fuyuka and Amemiya Taiyou know each other and appeared for the first time in GO.

title: Non-defense! Maboroshi Shot!!!
overview:
The Pinball Stadium will appear for the first time. Genei Gakuen will appear and have a match with Raimon. This episode was delayed by a week because of the premiere of the Inazuma Eleven GO movie in Japan.

So, it was aired on January 4 at 6pm. Maboroshi Shot will appear for the first time in the anime.

title: The Shock! Goalkeeper's Subtitution!
overview: Aoyama Shunsuke and Kageyama Hikaru will play, and they will replace Kurama Norihito and Hamano Kaiji. Phantom Crystal Dalaman will appear for the first time. Hakono Zuiichi will play for Genei Gakuen and replaced Kyoki Sanetomi. Maboroshi Shot is beaten, by Amagi. Nishizono Shinsuke will play for the first time as goalkeeper and replaced Sangoku Taichi. Will Raimon win??

title: Reunion of Fate
overview:
Tenma meets Ishido Shuuji for the first time. 

Shindou is seen at Tenma's house. Some players from Arakumo Gakuen will appear and they are seen having a match with a unknown team at Cyclone Stadium.

title: A Genius of Glasswork
overview: Tachimukai Yuuki and Toramaru reappear in GO. Tachimukai is seen giving tips to Nishizono Shinsuke on being a goalkeeper. Minamisawa and Hyoudou reappear and have a practice match with Raimon to help Shinsuke. Amemiya Taiyou is seen talking with Ishido Shuuji. Nishizono Shinsuke manage to pull out his Keshin but the appearance of the Keshin was never shown in the episode and he managed to stop Tsurugi 's Lost Angel, which could mean Nishizono's Keshin is very strong. Amemiya Taiyou is charged off the hospital but Fuyuka stated that he can never play soccer again. Ichinose, Mark and Dylan are seen at Gouenji's flashback.

title: Taiyou's Keshin Unleashed
overview: Raimon is introduced to Arakumo Gakuen and also on the Desert Stadium, but Taiyou is nowhere to be seen on the team. Raimon then makes their way to the stadium where they begin practicing for the match, until they find an orange haired boy walking towards the stadium, then revealed to be Taiyou. Otonashi explains that Taiyou is a forward for Arakumo Gakuen. While practicing, Taiyou approaches Tenma and starts to say how he had always loved to play soccer, and wanted to play against Tenma when seeing him on TV in a match. Before the match starts, the whole of Raimon is surprised when seeing Taiyou as the captain.

title: Tenma VS Taiyou
overview: Majin Pegasus Arc will appear. The second half started. There will be an explosion between Majin Pegasus Arc and Taiyou Shin Apollo. Amemiya Taiyou seems better from his illness.

title: The New Captain! Matsukaze Tenma
overview: Coach Endou will return. Tenma will be appointed as the new captain of Raimon.

title: Battle! Amano Mikado Stadium
overview: Tsurugi and Tenma tries to learn Fire Tornado DD. The Amano Mikado Stadium will reappear. Someone pays for Tsurugi Yuuichi surgery. Tenma will be seen for the first time with the captain's band in the Holy Road. The match opposing Raimon to Seidouzan is about to start.

title: The Strongest Enemy Appears! Dragonlink
overview: The first half of the match will end. Dragonlink will appear.

title: Heroic! The Last Battle
overview: The second half begins, and all of the players of Seidouzan are replaced. Fifth Sector's founder, Senguuji Daigo, becomes the coach and leads Dragonlink. Raimon turns to fighting with avatars during the match.

title: Reach for the Sky! Everyone's Soccer
overview:
Despairing over his strategy failing, Tenma lost his confidence as the captain of his team. He was suddenly motivated by Shindou who came into the stadium. After that, they started to do their own soccer and Tenma uses all his effort. Aiming for victory, the final fight against Dragonlink begins.And finally Raimon wins the match.Tenma holding the trophy

Added by Tsurugi-kun

title: The Pass to Tomorrow
overview: Dragonlink lost against Raimon.When people get to enjoy free soccer again,Raimon went back to practice. Believing in the best teamates ,they acheived the best soccer .Tenma,with the soccer ball which led him in the revolution till now,starts to reflect on his past.....

title: The TV Reporter is Here!
overview: A reporter came by and asked young soccer players such as the members of the Inazuma KFC and asked which persons do they liked in the Raimon team. During this interview, the Raimon team is seen watching and they reflect on how long they struggled to free soccer.

title: This is the Raimon Soccer Club!
overview: The interview continues and this time, they interview Endou Mamoru and Kino Aki about the past. Endou then retells the story of how it all started back ten years before. After the interview, Matsukaze Tenma was inspired of what Endou has said and promised to do play soccer more. But near the end, another organization called El Dorado is shown to be watching from behind the scenes...
